bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
base=6e2440be485b39ebd66e8e3d5b29ddf6ab583b95
head=75f585d7471d56114e4275e850a63d6caff10cb5
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 61
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 62
git -C "$root" fetch --no-tags origin refs/heads/chat/link-button-master-final-20261120 >/dev/null
test "$(git -C "$root" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$head" || exit 63
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/link62-userbot.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
for name in userbot_resident_ipc.py userbot_test_client.py; do
 git -C "$root" show "$base:scripts/$name" >"$tmp/base-$name"
 git -C "$root" show "$head:scripts/$name" >"$tmp/new-$name"
 cmp -s "$tmp/base-$name" "$root/scripts/$name" || exit 64
 python3 -B -c 'import ast,sys;ast.parse(open(sys.argv[1],encoding="utf8").read())' "$tmp/new-$name" || exit 65
done
test -S "$root/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock" || test -S "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock" || exit 66
dir="$HOME/.local/state/link-pr62-userbot"
mkdir -p "$dir"
for name in userbot_resident_ipc.py userbot_test_client.py; do
 if test -e "$dir/$name.rollback"; then cmp -s "$dir/$name.rollback" "$tmp/base-$name" || exit 67
 else cp -p "$root/scripts/$name" "$dir/$name.rollback"; fi
done
restore(){
 for name in userbot_resident_ipc.py userbot_test_client.py; do
  cp -p "$dir/$name.rollback" "$root/scripts/$name"
 done
 systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
}
trap restore ERR
for name in userbot_resident_ipc.py userbot_test_client.py; do
 cp "$tmp/new-$name" "$root/scripts/$name"
done
systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service
sleep 4
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 68
(cd "$root/scripts" && python3 -B userbot_test_client.py health >/dev/null) || exit 69
(cd "$root/scripts" && python3 -B userbot_test_client.py link_button_smoke >/dev/null) || exit 70
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 71
trap - ERR
echo LINK_BUTTON_USERBOT_CLICK=PASS
echo USERBOT_SESSION_PRESERVED=PASS
echo OTHER_FEATURES_UNCHANGED=PASS
